preparation.description: Osocimab Fv from 6HHC: VH 120 aa, VL 107 aa. Editable VH positions: 97–109 for HCDR3-only, or 26–33/51–58/97–109 for HCDR123. Framework and VL are fixed.

tools.name: VL identity, VH length, protected residues and mask checks

outcome.summary: Best recovery is 0.6923 (HCDR3) and 0.7241 (HCDR123). Geometry leader t014r001_hcdr123_scope_s05 has AAR 0.6897, nine substitutions, Fv deviation 0.3978 Å and HCDR3 deviation 1.3367 Å from the predicted native Fv.
